title: I’m Afraid I Can’t Do That: Predicting Prompt Refusal in Black-Box Generative Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the likelihood of ChatGPT refusing a prompt based on its content. In terms of faith/religion, this involved analyzing whether prompts containing terms related to religious groups or conflicts (e.g., 'muslims', 'Hindu versus Muslim conflicts') were predictive of refusal.
findings: Prompts mentioning demographic groups in plural form, including 'muslims', were found to be among the strongest predictors of refusal by ChatGPT. The source data for prompts (Quora Insincere Questions) was noted to contain many questions concerning 'Hindu versus Muslim conflicts'.
